title: 胡萝卜组织培养（国内版）
source_doc: course/Animal & Plant Biotech Safety/07_APB - Culturing Carrots.md
author_source: project/Animal & Plant Biotech Safety/07_APB - Culturing Carrots（国内版）/src.py

points.S3: 实验室里的胡萝卜不能吃
points.S4: 转基因实验：先评估，再审批
points.S5: 菌株与质粒的管理和灭活
points.S6: 转基因植物不得带出、不随意丢

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着一根带叶子的胡萝卜，身旁是一排装着绿色小苗的培养瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot hugs a fresh carrot with green leaves, standing beside a row of culture jars with tiny green plantlets.
shots.narration: 这一课讲胡萝卜的组织培养。

shots.scene: 胡萝卜、培养皿、小苗、花盆四个图标用箭头连成一圈
shots.prompt_en: Four icons connected by arrows in a circle: a carrot, a petri dish, a small plantlet and a flower pot. No people.
shots.narration: 一小片胡萝卜，怎样长成一棵新苗？

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一根胡萝卜和一把小刀，在实验台前比划
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a carrot and a small knife at the lab bench, about to cut it toward his own palm.
shots.narration: 阿杰拿起胡萝卜，刀口朝着手心就要切。

shots.scene: 阿杰咬了一口胡萝卜，旁边是打开的培养基瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes a bite of a raw carrot next to open bottles of culture medium on the lab bench.
shots.narration: 切完还想尝一口：这不就是蔬菜嘛？

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，指着实验台上的禁止饮食标志
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops the young male student and points at a no eating or drinking sign on the wall.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：实验材料，不能吃。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 组培既讲技术，也讲安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着空白笔记本，旁边是暂停、回放图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank notebook and a pen, next to pause and replay icons.
shots.narration: 边看边记，没看懂就暂停回看。

shots.scene: 阿杰翻开笔记本，上面画着蕨叶图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student opens his notebook to a page with a fern leaf sketch and blank lines.
shots.narration: 之前做过蕨类组培，工具和流程还记得吗？

shots.scene: 蕨叶图标和胡萝卜图标之间的等号箭头
shots.prompt_en: A fern leaf icon and a carrot icon linked by a double arrow, with a transfer chamber icon above them. No people.
shots.narration: 胡萝卜组培，用的是同一套无菌方法。

shots.scene: 王老师在讲台前，身后是空白屏幕上的胡萝卜图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stands at the front of a classroom with a carrot pictogram on a blank screen.
shots.narration: 这一课，补充胡萝卜培养的知识。

shots.scene: 胡萝卜在水龙头下冲洗
shots.prompt_en: A carrot with its leaves trimmed being rinsed under a tap. No people.
shots.narration: 第一步，把胡萝卜的直根洗干净，

shots.scene: 胡萝卜被分成几段的示意图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a carrot divided into three or four short pieces. No people.
shots.narration: 切成几段，

shots.scene: 一段胡萝卜上取出圆柱形芯的示意图
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a cylindrical core taken from the center of a carrot piece. No people.
shots.narration: 用打孔器在中间取出一根芯，

shots.scene: 无菌培养皿里一排薄圆片
shots.prompt_en: A row of thin carrot discs lying in an open sterile petri dish. No people.
shots.narration: 在无菌培养皿里切成薄片，

shots.scene: 圆片放在淡黄色培养基上
shots.prompt_en: Carrot discs placed on pale yellow gel medium in a petri dish. No people.
shots.narration: 放到诱导愈伤组织的培养基上。

shots.scene: 流程循环图：圆片、愈伤、小苗、花盆
shots.prompt_en: A circular flow diagram of icons: carrot discs, a lumpy callus, a plantlet with roots and shoots, and a potted carrot plant. No people.
shots.narration: 愈伤、生根生芽，最后长成新植株。

shots.scene: 胡萝卜剖面，直根里有能量图标
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway icon of a carrot plant with its long orange taproot glowing with a small energy symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 胡萝卜是直根，根里储存着能量，

shots.scene: 餐盘里切好的胡萝卜
shots.prompt_en: Sliced carrots on a dinner plate. No people.
shots.narration: 也就是我们平常吃的部分。

shots.scene: 一棵母株旁边是几棵一模一样的小苗
shots.prompt_en: A parent carrot plant beside several identical small carrot plantlets. No people.
shots.narration: 用它能培育出一模一样的克隆苗。

shots.scene: 试管里的小苗，旁边一只玻璃杯图标
shots.prompt_en: A small plantlet growing on gel inside a glass culture tube, next to a glass beaker icon. No people.
shots.narration: 在试管、培养皿里培养，叫离体培养。

shots.scene: 培养基上的圆片慢慢长出淡黄色的团块
shots.prompt_en: Carrot discs on gel medium slowly growing pale yellow lumpy callus. No people.
shots.narration: 几周后，圆片上长出愈伤组织。

shots.scene: 镊子把愈伤组织转到新的培养皿
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands with forceps transfer a piece of callus into a fresh petri dish of medium inside a transfer chamber.
shots.narration: 再转到含生长素的新培养基上，

shots.scene: 愈伤组织上冒出白色细根和绿色小芽
shots.prompt_en: Callus sprouting tiny white roots and small green shoots on gel medium. No people.
shots.narration: 又过几周，长出细小的根和芽。

shots.scene: 带根带芽的小苗图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tiny plantlet with both roots and leaves. No people.
shots.narration: 这时的新生长体，叫小植株。

shots.scene: 培养皿里一簇挤在一起的小苗
shots.prompt_en: A cluster of tiny plantlets crowded together in one petri dish. No people.
shots.narration: 小苗挨得太近，会长成一簇。

shots.scene: 小研在转移室里用消毒过的镊子分开小苗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in gloves gently separates plantlets with forceps inside a transfer chamber, a disinfectant cup nearby.
shots.narration: 分株时仍要无菌，工具先消毒。

shots.scene: 小苗旁边一把尺子
shots.prompt_en: A small plantlet standing beside a ruler. No people.
shots.narration: 苗长到合适高度，分株移栽更容易活。

shots.scene: 小苗从培养瓶移到装无土基质的小盆
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands move a hardened plantlet from a culture jar into a small pot of soil-less potting mix.
shots.narration: 炼苗后，移到无土基质里，

shots.scene: 几个小盆里的小苗，有的再分开
shots.prompt_en: Several small pots with growing carrot seedlings, one clump being divided again. No people.
shots.narration: 长大了，需要时再分一次。

shots.scene: 阿杰在生长室前拿着空白记录表
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands in front of a growth chamber with lighted shelves, holding a blank record sheet.
shots.narration: 培养期间，要定时查看生长室，

shots.scene: 温度计、试纸、灯泡和时钟四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a thermometer, a pH test strip, a light bulb and a clock. No people.
shots.narration: 温度、酸碱度、光照时长都要记录。

shots.scene: 窗外阳光直射培养瓶被打叉，灯光照射打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: sunlight through a window onto culture jars crossed out with a red X, and a lamp above culture jars with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 阳光直晒会杀死培养物，要用灯光。

shots.scene: 一小块组织旁边是一大瓶培养基
shots.prompt_en: A tiny piece of plant tissue next to a large bottle of culture medium. No people.
shots.narration: 组培只用一点点组织，

shots.scene: 培养基瓶里浮现几个成分图标
shots.prompt_en: A culture medium bottle with several ingredient icons floating out of it. No people.
shots.narration: 生长所需的一切，都要靠培养基。

shots.scene: 方糖图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of sugar cubes with a carbon atom symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 蔗糖，提供碳源；

shots.scene: 维生素药片图标和健康小苗
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a vitamin capsule next to a healthy green plantlet. No people.
shots.narration: 维生素，让小苗健康；

shots.scene: 细胞一分为二并变大的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a plant cell dividing into two and growing larger. No people.
shots.narration: 生长素，促进细胞分裂和增大；

shots.scene: 液体倒进培养皿后凝成胶状
shots.prompt_en: An icon of liquid poured into a petri dish turning into firm gel. No people.
shots.narration: 琼脂，让培养基凝固。

shots.scene: 培养基上小苗旁冒出细菌和霉菌图标
shots.prompt_en: A petri dish where bacteria and mold icons appear next to a plantlet. No people.
shots.narration: 细菌和真菌，也喜欢这样的环境。

shots.scene: 整洁的转移室，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A clean, tidy transfer chamber with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 所以培养全程，都要保持无菌。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在整洁的实验台前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a tidy lab bench.
shots.narration: 无菌，护苗；安全，护人。

shots.scene: 打孔器和小刀的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a metal cork borer and a small scalpel. No people.
shots.narration: 打孔器和刀，都可能扎伤割伤。

shots.scene: 手掌托着胡萝卜往下打孔的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cork borer pressed down into a carrot held in the palm of a hand, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别把材料托在手心里打孔、切片。

shots.scene: 胡萝卜段放在培养皿里，打孔器垂直向下
shots.prompt_en: A carrot piece resting flat in a sterile petri dish on the bench, a cork borer held vertically above it by a gloved hand.
shots.narration: 垫在稳固的台面上，用力方向远离手。

shots.scene: 用过的刀片放进锐器盒
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands drop a used blade into a yellow sharps container.
shots.narration: 用完的刀片，放进锐器盒。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜和手套在称量药品
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing goggles, gloves and a lab coat weighs powder on a balance.
shots.narration: 配培养基，要称药品、调酸碱度，

shots.scene: 酸碱试剂瓶上的腐蚀标志
shots.prompt_en: Blank reagent bottles with corrosive hazard pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 酸碱溶液有腐蚀性，戴好护目镜。

shots.scene: 植物激素试剂瓶放进带锁的试剂柜
shots.prompt_en: Small blank reagent bottles placed on a shelf inside a lockable reagent cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 激素等试剂，按化学品管理。

shots.section_title: 实验室里的胡萝卜不能吃
shots.scene: 实验台上吃胡萝卜的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person eating a carrot at a lab bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里的胡萝卜，不能吃。
overlay: 实验室里的胡萝卜不能吃

shots.section_title: 实验室里的胡萝卜不能吃
shots.scene: 禁止饮食标志
shots.prompt_en: A no eating or drinking sign on a lab door. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里不吃不喝。

shots.section_title: 实验室里的胡萝卜不能吃
shots.scene: 阿杰摘手套后洗手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student removes his gloves and washes his hands at the sink.
shots.narration: 离开前摘手套、洗手。

shots.section_title: 转基因实验：先评估，再审批
shots.scene: DNA双螺旋和胡萝卜图标之间有问号
shots.prompt_en: A DNA double helix icon and a carrot icon with a question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 把基因导入植物，就是转基因实验。
overlay: 转基因实验：先评估，再审批

shots.section_title: 转基因实验：先评估，再审批
shots.scene: 老周和王老师在看空白的申请表
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the safety administrator review a blank application form at a desk.
shots.narration: 动手之前，先做风险评估，

shots.section_title: 转基因实验：先评估，再审批
shots.scene: 空白文件上盖章的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a blank document receiving an approval stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 按规定报审批准，才能开始。

shots.section_title: 转基因实验：先评估，再审批
shots.scene: 阿杰只在纸上写方案，旁边是笔记本
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes a plan on blank paper at a desk, no lab equipment nearby.
shots.narration: 课堂作业写方案，不等于可以去做。

shots.section_title: 菌株与质粒的管理和灭活
shots.scene: 冻存盒和登记本图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a freezer storage box with small tubes and a blank logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 用到的菌株和质粒，要登记管理。
overlay: 菌株与质粒的管理和灭活

shots.section_title: 菌株与质粒的管理和灭活
shots.scene: 带锁的冰箱图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a laboratory freezer with a padlock and a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 专柜保存，专人负责。

shots.section_title: 菌株与质粒的管理和灭活
shots.scene: 含菌废液和培养皿进高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands load a blank autoclave bag of used culture plates into an autoclave.
shots.narration: 用过的菌液和平板，先灭活再处理。

shots.section_title: 菌株与质粒的管理和灭活
shots.scene: 倒进水槽的菌液图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of liquid culture being poured down a sink, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 菌液不能直接倒进水槽。

shots.section_title: 转基因植物不得带出、不随意丢
shots.scene: 生长室门上的生物危害标志和空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A growth chamber door with a biohazard warning sign and a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 转基因植物，要在指定地点培养。
overlay: 转基因植物不得带出、不随意丢

shots.section_title: 转基因植物不得带出、不随意丢
shots.scene: 装着小苗的花盆放进书包被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a potted seedling being put into a backpack, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能带回宿舍或家里，

shots.section_title: 转基因植物不得带出、不随意丢
shots.scene: 小苗扔进普通垃圾桶被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of plantlets being thrown into an ordinary trash can, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 也不能随手扔掉。

shots.section_title: 转基因植物不得带出、不随意丢
shots.scene: 王老师在空白登记表上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank disposal record form.
shots.narration: 灭活后按规定处置，并登记。

shots.scene: 笔记本上三处高亮的空白条
shots.prompt_en: A blank notebook page with three highlighted blank lines. No people.
shots.narration: 看完标出三个要点，

shots.scene: 新旧两个笔记本用箭头相连
shots.prompt_en: Two notebook icons connected by arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 想想和学过的知识有什么联系，

shots.scene: 阿杰举手提问
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to ask the safety administrator a question.
shots.narration: 有疑问就问老师，笔记要保管好。

shots.scene: DNA被剪刀剪开、复制、插入的三格图标
shots.prompt_en: Three simple icons in a row: a DNA strand cut by scissors, the strand copied, and a piece inserted into a longer strand. No people.
shots.narration: 接下来的任务：写一份导入基因的方案，

shots.scene: 胡萝卜和麦穗、谷物图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a carrot, a wheat ear and a bowl of grain with an up arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 理解基因工程怎样服务农业生产。

shots.scene: 王老师在讲台前讲解任务
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains the assignment to the class in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 具体要求，听老师安排。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现胡萝卜、愈伤和小苗图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a carrot, a callus and a plantlet.
shots.narration: 取材、愈伤、生根生芽、移栽。

shots.scene: 温度计、灯泡、培养基瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a thermometer, a lamp and a culture medium bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 培养基配得对，条件记得全。

shots.scene: 锐器盒和禁止饮食标志
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a yellow sharps container and a no eating or drinking sign. No people.
shots.narration: 刀具小心用，材料不能吃。

shots.scene: 盖章文件、高压灭菌器、打叉的书包图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a stamped blank document, an autoclave, and a backpack crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 转基因先审批，菌株要灭活，苗不带走。

shots.scene: 欣欣在一排健康的胡萝卜小苗旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a row of healthy carrot seedlings in small pots.
shots.narration: 无菌育苗，安全实验，下次见！
